movelist.name: Jump Kick
movelist.effect: If Jump Kick misses, the user loses Hit Points equal to 1/4th of their Max Hit Points. A failure to hit due to a Move with the Shield keyword does not count as a miss. This Move cannot be used if Gravity is in effect.

movelist.name: Return
movelist.effect: Return’s Damage Base is equal to 3 plus the user’s Loyalty Value.

movelist.name: Endure
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a damaging Move, you may use Endure as a Free Action. If the Move would bring Endure’s user down to 0 Hit Points or less, Endure’s user instead is set to 1 Hit Point.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.trigger: A foe of the opposite gender attacks the user

abilities.name: Vigor
abilities.effect: Connection – Endure. When this Ability is activated, after being set to 1 Hit Point, the user gains a Tick of Hit Points. Furthermore, if the Move that triggered Endure gave the user an Injury from Massive Damage, the user does not gain that Injury. Defensive.
